pair_set_used.coincidence_population: conventions.coincidence_selection: any same-value, different-referent pair, no context constraint
pair_set_used.comparison: SUPERSESSION versus INTERFERENCE only. The claim is about those two operations, so COINCIDENCE and DUPLICATE never enter the ceiling; they appear in the harm table, where a merge policy does act on them.
pair_set_used.confound: task 001: interference pairs are 100 percent same-workstream, supersession only 53 percent. Both effects push toward overlap, which favours our own claim, so the same-topic-stratified ceiling is primary and the marginal one is a companion
pair_set_used.interference_population: conventions.interference_selection: same-workstream pairs only, because a merge policy fires above tau and only colliding pairs ever reach a classifier
pair_set_used.sample_vs_derivable: pairs.jsonl is a labelled SAMPLE; every derivable number relabels pairs from episodes.jsonl through brain.corpus.relations.pair_of, so absence from the sample is never treated as a negative label
